appDescription: Records driver-reported intermittent symptoms with available vehicle observations for a service consultation.

function.name: START_SYMPTOM_RECORD
function.description: Starts a symptom record after recording preparation has been enabled by the driver.

note.description: The symptom description supplied by the driver.

function.name: ADD_SYMPTOM_NOTE
function.description: Adds a driver symptom description or marks the current moment in the active record.

note.description: The symptom description supplied by the driver.

markMoment.description: Whether the driver wants to mark the current symptom moment.

function.name: END_SYMPTOM_RECORD
function.description: Stops observation collection and saves the active symptom record.
